preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of selected vertices k must be greater than zero.
The number of distinct selected vertices must equal k.

postconditions.expression: all(not (x in selected_vertices and y in selected_vertices) for x, y in edges)
postconditions.description: No two selected vertices can be directly connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x in selected_vertices and y in reachable_from_x) or (x in reachable_from_x and y in reachable_from_z) for x in selected_vertices for z in reachable_from_x) for y in range(1, n + 1) if y not in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in the selected set must be reachable from some vertex in the selected set in at most two moves.
